messages:
Maya (Recruiter): Karen accepted the L5 offer last night. She just messaged that her visa appointment opened earlier and she needs to start 2026-04-12 instead of 2026-05-01. We already approved a $15k sign-on scheduled at 90 days.
Ravi (Hiring Manager): Team can shift onboarding forward. Candidate says she needs ~60% up front to cover filing fees and travel.
Leah (People Ops): Two paths: (A) frontload 60% of sign-on (requires comp exception + amendment + payroll PR) or (B) one-off visa stipend with receipts. Visa funds need to be traceable. Which do you prefer?
Maya (Recruiter): Manager prefers A. Candidate is OK signing an amendment today.
Theo (Comp): Please include manager justification (visa urgency) and confirm base salary unchanged. If complete I can fast-track to comp chair.
Visa-Bot: FYI candidate needs paid confirmation to secure 04/18 appointment. Delaying payment risks missing consulate slot.
Leah (People Ops): Created REQ-2026-5555 and escalated to Comp Chair. Target decision 2026-04-07 EOD.
Theo (Comp): Approved 60% frontload under "visa compliance support". Add standard <90-day clawback. Chair signed.
Leah (People Ops): Legal posted amendment AMEND-811. Payroll needs PR and signed amendment by 2026-04-07 15:00 PT to hit 2026-04-12 run.
Payroll Bot: PR#811-VISA received. Scheduling $9,000 on 04/12 and remainder $6,000 on 07/01.
Maya (Recruiter): Karen signed AMEND-811 (attached). Start confirmed 2026-04-12. Candidate booked appointment 04/18. :tada:
Ravi (Hiring Manager): Updated onboarding plan and prework.
Leah (People Ops): Logged exception in HRIS and closing REQ-2026-5555. Thanks everyone.
